topic: Staged Memory discovery and contextual first-run guidance
currentUserGoal: Reveal fewer Memory nodes at once, guide new players through the live systems, and make the opening loop immediately easier to understand and engage with.
workCompleted: Replaced broad type-based Memory visibility with graph-driven discovery prerequisites.
Reduced the first post-Tiny-Sprinkler Memory frontier from 12 visible nodes to 8.
Staged each helper cluster so its speed Memory appears first, speed reveals efficiency and storage, storage reveals starting stock, and efficiency reveals the alternate mode.
Preserved the existing no-crossing connector geometry by separating visual prerequisites from discovery prerequisites.
Added Run 1 contextual guidance: the first prompt asks for the waking touch, then a Memory-forming progress bar explains recovery timing and the permanent reward from collapse.
Removed the duplicate first-touch callout that overlapped the new guide.
Moved successful-touch reward text below the guide during Run 1.
Updated the Memory Grove subtitle to explain that remembering a node reveals its attached discoveries.
Updated the accessible DOM state with the same first-run lesson.
verificationRun: Focused Memory Tree and Ecosystem System tests passed: 67 tests.
npm run check passed: ESLint, 205 Vitest tests across 24 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
A clean first run collapsed in approximately 17 seconds and awarded the guaranteed 7 Grass Touches.
The first Memory Grove showed only Tiny Sprinkler; remembering it revealed the expected 8-node frontier.
Buying Clockwork Nozzle revealed exactly Fine Mist and Dew Cistern, while starting stock and mode remained hidden.
Desktop and 390x844 phone checks showed no guidance or reward-text overlap.
The browser reported no warnings or errors.
knownIssues: The discovery cadence now needs a hands-on multi-run judgment before release.
The first frontier still deliberately includes the root touch, vitality, field-size, automation-speed, and next-helper choices.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this slice.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play through the first three Groves and judge whether each reveal feels exciting rather than restrictive.
Prototype Tending Rhythm: successful recovered touches build a short streak, with a five-touch Dew Surge that rewards cadence without making Run 1 survivable.
Add contextual Field Notes that highlight the exact control or resource named by the active objective.
Introduce later Scourge omens only after the touch rhythm proves fun, so two new engagement systems are not balanced simultaneously.
doNotRevert: Do not reconnect all helper rank and mode nodes to immediate visibility; the staged discovery order is intentional.
Do not restore the duplicate TOUCH THE GRASS TO BEGIN field callout.
Do not place touch reward text over the fixed Run 1 guidance strip.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
